# Data index

What the large generated files hold, so you never have to open them.
For anything more specific: `node work/query.mjs <unit|mesh|item|layer> <term>`.

## `outputs/mesh-index.js` — GENERATED, never hand-edit

1686 structure rows resolving to 796 study units.
Rebuild: `node work/build-course-terms.mjs` (needs the Drive) then `node work/build-mesh-index.mjs`.

One row per named structure per layer, collapsed across side letters and
Blender duplicate suffixes. Row shape:

```js
{ name, layer, mesh, sides, tier, unitId, unit, unitKind, unitSize, isUnit,
  source: { file, subject, evidence } | null }
```

- `tier` — `0` the course names it, `1` finer than the course goes.
- `unit` — what a tap actually selects. Every row resolves to one.
- `sides` — `b` both, `l`, `r`, or `''` unpaired.
- `source` — non-null only for tier-0 rows; the course file that names it.

## `outputs/synonyms.js`

- `SYNONYMS` — 351 query expansions (collarbone→clavicle, CN X→vagus).
- `COMPOSITES` — 5 names with no mesh but real parts.
  Auditory ossicles, Eyeball, Larynx, Pharynx, Thymus
- `NOT_MODELLED` — 3 things genuinely absent:
  breast, skin, uterus

**Before writing a new `NOT_MODELLED` entry, check it against the index.**
`work/search-probe.mjs` fails the build if a NOT_MODELLED term names a mesh that exists.
